question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over China’s Communist Party apparatus and military ahead of the 2027 National Congress, with recent purges of senior generals and Politburo figures reinforcing rather than eroding his authority. Extensive anti-corruption drives and personnel reshuffles have eliminated potential rivals and installed loyalists, while the recent Beidaihe conclave focused on preparations for his expected fourth term rather than any leadership transition. Traders’ 95.9% implied probability that he remains in office through 2026 reflects this structural dominance and the absence of credible challenges. Potential disruptions remain limited to unforeseen health events, a major external crisis triggering elite realignment, or an abrupt reversal in purge dynamics before the congress.
